findings.title: Penang destination results repeatedly return HTTP 503
findings.severity_rationale: The Penang browse path is unavailable, but other destinations remain usable; impact is localized to users seeking Penang stays.
findings.impact: Users cannot browse Penang properties through the Discover destination selector.
steps: Repeat the same selection; compare with Langkawi or Cameron Highlands.
findings.expected: Penang results should load or the UI should show a genuine no-results state rather than a service-unavailable failure.
findings.expected_basis: Penang is a visible destination option and a Penang property (The George) is shown in the default collection; comparison destinations load normally.
findings.actual: Three Penang selections returned HTTP 503. The UI showed a temporary-unavailability alert and no matching cards.
findings.comparison: Kuala Lumpur returned two stays, Langkawi three, and Cameron Highlands two. Root cause not established.
findings.recommendation: Restore the Penang listing endpoint and verify the destination option against the available Penang stay record; retain the visible recoverable error state for genuine outages.

findings.title: The Moss House quote accepts more guests than its stated room limit
findings.severity_rationale: A single property's quote allows a party above its stated maximum, which can produce an invalid reservation attempt; users can avoid the issue by selecting four or fewer guests.
findings.impact: Guests may receive a quote and proceed with an occupancy the property explicitly says it cannot accommodate.
preconditions: The Moss House detail page is open
steps: Select six guests, or arrive from Discover with six selected.
Observe the quote and Continue to reservation control.
findings.expected: Guest options and quote validation must prevent or reject a party larger than four for one room.
findings.expected_basis: The detail page states Up to 4 guests and A maximum of 4 guests.
findings.actual: The selector offers 5 and 6; selecting 6 generated a successful quote (RM 3,726.00 for three nights) and left Continue to reservation available.
findings.comparison: Serena Villas also states a four-guest maximum; no over-capacity check was performed there. Root cause not established.
findings.recommendation: Constrain the detail selector to the room's maximum and enforce the same limit in quote validation before enabling reservation continuation.

limitations: Assessment is partial; authenticated workflows remain untested because no test account was supplied.
Reservation continuation, account-specific saved stays/bookings, and any payment stage were not attempted.
House rules disclosure was discovered but not opened.
Date/guest availability search behavior is unclear; the primary button scrolled to the destination-filtered collection and no separate results route was observed.
Performance was not measured; available network listings did not expose durations.
Accessibility coverage was sampled only; no WCAG conformance claim is made.
The supplied HTML report template contains only a run-details/footer fragment (19 lines). The report uses that run-details design, the supplied CSS, and the Markdown template's section outline.
